scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Sikkim
other_conditions: Applicant must not have any source of income
Applicant must not be a recipient of salary, pension, or family pension from the Central Government or any other State Government
Applicant must have opened a bank account under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana scheme
Only one member per family is eligible; in case of death, the pension may be transferred to the spouse if the spouse is aged 60 or above
Beneficiary must submit a life certificate in the prescribed format every November
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1500, ₹2000 or ₹2500 depending on the beneficiary’s age, payable as long as the beneficiary is alive.
